risks.risk: The exact model is unknown, and the model sets the price.
risks.proof: Photo of the front of the body showing the model name, or the base plate label with model and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Not priced until the model is read.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on, or shutter, sensor or autofocus may be faulty.
risks.proof: Clip powering on, taking a burst of shots and showing one sample photo on the rear screen.

risks.risk: High shutter count close to the rated life.
risks.proof: Screenshot of a shutter count reading, or the file EXIF from a fresh photo.
risks.if_unproven: As near end of shutter life.

risks.risk: Lens mount, sensor or front body damage, and no lens, battery or charger included.
risks.proof: Photo of the front with the body cap off showing the mount and mirror, plus all included items laid out.
risks.if_unproven: As body only, no battery or charger.

risks.risk: Serial may not match, or the camera may be stolen.
risks.proof: Base plate serial photo beside a handwritten note with today's date.
risks.if_unproven: Hold the deal until the serial is shown.

proof_requests: Photo of the front showing the model name and the base plate label with serial.
Clip powering on and taking a burst, then showing a sample photo on the screen.
Photo of the lens mount and mirror with the cap off.
Photo of every included item: battery, charger, strap, any lens.
response.reason: Canon is readable but the model, which sets the price, is not shown, and the specs come only from the seller's words; a front or base plate photo is needed before even a worst case price.
